'''Shockball''', '''shock ball''' or '''shock-ball''' was an outdoor team sport where players attempted to stun members of the opposing team using an electrically charged ball. Special equipment was required to play, including ball scoops to fling the orb and insulating mitts to handle it. The winning team was the one with the most conscious members after a certain amount of time had elapsed.<ref name="GSWU" /> Teams included the [[Quent Assassins]], the [[Royal Shockball Team]], the [[Shad Furies/Legends|Shad Furies]], and the [[Bonadan Blasters]].<ref name="HSCS" /> [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] also had teams, and faced each other in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], with the game resulting in a tie. [[Soly Kantt]] was a fan of the sport and would purchase [[gizer ale]] for the finals.<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents discovered a sinister [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] operation. Top shockball players were subjected to thought-control drugs by Imperial Intelligence and used as unwitting Imperial assassins and saboteurs. The galaxy-class professional athletes proved to be deadly operatives. When [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan spies]] discovered the heavily guarded headquarters of this operation, a Rebel strike team was sent to destroy it.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Rebel|Imperial Mind Control Plot}}</ref>

[[Regenald Hanniper Snopps III]], son of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zafiel Snopps]], was an accomplished shockball player.<ref name="SR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref>
